prompt: A narrow side street at night in a 1920s city, a 16:9 picture filling the frame edge to edge. A crashed getaway sedan burns against a lamp post, its bonnet crumpled and every window blown out. A locked 35mm lens at chest height looks up slightly at a crew of three clean-shaven men in their sixties and seventies, packed shoulder to shoulder in the foreground, weathered faces large in the frame, near-frontal, all mouths wide open in a shout, one raising a drum-fed submachine gun straight up at arm's length, clear of the faces. Yellow-white fire rims their hats from behind. A turquoise bulb canopy of a dark theatre with blank letter boards lights their faces and mouths. A plate-glass shopfront beside them doubles the fire and the turquoise bulbs. Thanks.
